rapport_notes: Stayed patient and professional through a difficult, argumentative call (neck pain, repeated price pushback, distrust of the time estimate).

evidence_quotes.agenda: not asked — call moved straight from intake into item/logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised several real concerns (glass bar/pool table damage history, fear of slow/untrained movers); each got one substantive reassurance answer but no deeper follow-up questions.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: we don't charge for our movers['] breaks and we have professionally train[ed] movers...not like a daily contracted workers (commit-to-rate); this is just an estimate...let's say it ends four hours then we will just be charging you for four hours (window + beats-it-pay-less).

top_strength: Stayed calm and substantive through a customer who repeatedly challenged the time estimate as impossible, without getting defensive or dismissive.
coaching_note: No explicit 'would you like our help with your move' ask was made (understandable since photos/booking were still pending) — flag it as a follow-up-call must when she sends the photos back.
